# Vendored Ossie core schema

`ossie-schema.json`, `LICENSE`, and `NOTICE` are unmodified copies from
[apache/ossie](https://github.com/apache/ossie/tree/28365cd638f3833765c5b940ada5b8cbc65f1c42),
commit `28365cd638f3833765c5b940ada5b8cbc65f1c42`.

The schema targets `0.2.0.dev0` and is bundled for reproducible offline validation.
See `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` for the upstream Apache 2.0 license and attribution.
Changes to this pin require reviewing the importer profile and its rejection tests.
